steps.content: As the indulgent feast draws to a close, cleaners and dancers trade places on the stage.

The show now over, the performers collapse in exhaustion, removing makeup and changing clothes in a heavy, oppressive silence. No one notices that Sallie, the newcomer who made a fool of herself on stage, has returned. She says nothing as she drags herself to a corner and crouches against the wall.
Pain and soreness hit her all at once. She rubs her swollen knees and ankles, eyes filled with nothing but hatred.
To survive, she has to adapt. Mustering her strength, Sallie drags her body toward the huddle of performers and pricks up her ears.
